trail_ultra.description: Ultra-distance trail running (50km+). Demands time on feet, climbing strength, and mental resilience.

key_sessions.notes: Build to 3-4 hours by peak. Mimic race terrain - technical trails, elevation
Long Saturday + medium-long Sunday. Teaches running on tired legs
Hill repeats, stair climbing, or sustained climbs. Build climbing economy
Single-leg work, eccentric loading for downhills, core stability

phase_guidance.base: Focus on aerobic volume. Easy long runs building duration. Strength foundation.
phase_guidance.build: Add vertical gain. Increase long run terrain difficulty. Back-to-back weekends.
phase_guidance.peak: Race-simulation efforts. Nutrition/hydration practice. Course-specific prep.
phase_guidance.taper: Reduce volume 40-60%. Keep short sharp efforts. Rest legs for race day.

multi_day_mtb.description: Multi-day mountain bike stage race. Requires endurance, bike handling, and recovery between stages.

key_sessions.notes: Build to 3-4 hours. Include climbs and technical sections
Consecutive day riding to simulate stage race fatigue
Sustained climbing at race pace. Build climbing endurance
Core, lower back, shoulders for bike position. Single-leg power

phase_guidance.base: Build saddle time. Easy long rides. Strength and mobility focus.
phase_guidance.build: Add intensity on climbs. Increase ride duration. Technical skills.
phase_guidance.peak: Race-pace efforts. Equipment dialed. Practice nutrition strategy.
phase_guidance.taper: Short sharp rides. Keep legs fresh. Mental preparation.

road_cycling.description: Road cycling events. Sustained aerobic effort with group dynamics.

key_sessions.notes: Build endurance base. Include varied terrain

phase_guidance.base: Build aerobic base with volume. Easy spinning.
phase_guidance.build: Add tempo and threshold work. Group rides.

tournament.description: Multi-game tournament (Ultimate, Padel). High intensity with short recovery between games.

key_sessions.notes: Short sharp efforts mimicking game demands

phase_guidance.base: Build aerobic base to support repeated efforts.
phase_guidance.taper: Fresh legs. Light technical work only.
